name: Q&A Digest
description: Turn a conversation into the questions that were asked and the answers that were given.
outline: Identify each distinct question raised in the transcript, whether asked directly or implied.
Pair every question with the answer that was given, in two or three sentences.
Mark questions that stayed unanswered as open.
Keep the questions in the order they came up and word them clearly and neutrally.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
**Q: When does the new version ship?**
A: Planned for 12 May, pending the final test round.
